description: Shared building definitions, measurements, staffing, runtime packs and layout libraries. Civilization presets reference these records. Castle fortification IDs live under structure_blocks.castle for the independent castle planner.

building_packs.description: City building pack catalogue used by settlement generation.

common.scope: Shared city layout requirements for all civilizations, subsequent planner work and catalogue rebuilding. Structures are functional requirements, not one mesh or one mandatory instance each.

priority_definitions.core: Provide this service in a city, allowing explicitly planned shared buildings or supplied alternatives.
priority_definitions.conditional: Use only when the stated terrain, resource, economic or defensive conditions apply.
priority_definitions.specialist: Reserve for cities whose role, wealth, institutions or future gameplay justify it.

scale_policy.counts: Use civilization city-size preset quantities as provisional budgets; reconcile with population, throughput, terrain and area during placement.
scale_policy.sharing: Several functions may occupy one structure or courtyard. Shared occupancy must not duplicate service capacity.
scale_policy.geometry: Use explicit dimensions_m and clearance_m to reserve plot_m; do not scale randomly. Revise defaults after map and gameplay clearance prototypes.
scale_policy.world_budget: Do not give every city every specialist structure. Bound active detail and distant simulation separately.
scale_policy.housing: Dwellings, apartments, noble residences, guest rooms, dormitories and barracks sleeping accommodation are deferred.
scale_policy.asset_links: Reuse candidates are existing semantic references only, not complete coverage or approved assets. Empty lists identify gaps for the later catalogue rebuild.
scale_policy.state: Future construction, damage and ruins need supported state assets; these design rows do not enable new generator states.

measurement_convention.axes: Local X = width across frontage; local Z = depth away from front access edge; Y = height above local grade. Rotate the entire footprint, clearances and access together.
measurement_convention.footprint: dimensions_m bounds the building, compound or open area. Compound bounds include its named working yard. A height of zero means no enclosing building height; it does not mean no vegetation, equipment or terrain.
measurement_convention.plot: plot_m is the unrotated reservation: width + left + right, depth + front + rear. Clearances lie outside the footprint; road carriageways are separate. Shared courts/clearances require an explicit compatible layout, never automatic overlapping.
measurement_convention.linear: For linear_segment rows, width is corridor cross-section and depth is repeat length or illustrative bridge span. Fit a path with segments; do not tile ends as independent rectangular building plots. Height is above-grade extent, not terrain rise, ditch depth or bridge clearance.
measurement_convention.access: Access attaches at the front edge for buildings and compounds. Linear paths connect at both ends. minimum_clear_width_m is route clearance, not an implied door opening. Internal passages, turning swept paths, slopes and vertical clearance require later validation.
measurement_convention.terrain: No terrain suitability, foundation depth, underground depth, usable floor area, occupancy, flood clearance, rotor sweep or structural-span guarantee is inferred from these bounding boxes.
measurement_convention.variations: One medium-city planning size per requirement. Shared-use buildings and smaller/larger variants need explicit recipes; defaults are proposed game design, not measured historical buildings or final meshes.
measurement_convention.conversion: Future Unreal adapter converts metres to centimetres by multiplying by 100.

rural.scope: Dedicated rural hamlet layout requirements, separate from urban city blocks so cultural art can diverge.

priority_definitions.core: Provide this service in an ordinary support hamlet, allowing role-filtered alternatives.
priority_definitions.conditional: Use when local role, shore access or spare capacity justifies it.
priority_definitions.specialist: Reserve for rare rural roles; unused in the first hamlet presets.

scale_policy.counts: Use civilization hamlet preset quantities as provisional budgets.
scale_policy.sharing: Several functions may share a yard; do not double-count capacity.
scale_policy.geometry: Use explicit dimensions_m and clearance_m; do not scale randomly.
scale_policy.world_budget: Hamlets are numerous; keep footprints compact.
scale_policy.housing: Hamlet cottages use housing_profiles.hamlet_house, not city worker housing.
scale_policy.asset_links: Reuse candidates point at production ARCH hamlet assemblies where known.
scale_policy.state: Schematic potential states only; no Unreal mesh claim.

castle.scope: Castle fortification modules and bailey services for the independent castle planner. Not consumed by city or hamlet presets.

priority_definitions.core: Required by every typology kit that places this module.
priority_definitions.conditional: Used when a kit requests ditch, postern or barbican features.
priority_definitions.specialist: Landmark keep and great hall shells.

scale_policy.counts: Kit recipes own quantities; this library supplies measured shells.
scale_policy.sharing: Bailey courts are open compounds; keep tower is the command landmark.
scale_policy.geometry: Curtain uses linear_segment depth as repeat length along the wall path.
scale_policy.world_budget: Fortresses are few; allow larger wards than hamlets.
scale_policy.housing: Garrison beds deferred; not worker-house densification.
scale_policy.asset_links: Reuse candidates point at ARCH fortress assemblies where known.
scale_policy.state: Schematic potential states only; no Unreal mesh claim.

structures.name: Curtain wall segment
structures.purpose: Walkable curtain run with parapet between fortification nodes.
structures.placement: Along closed bailey or ward perimeter.
requirements: Compatible joins at both ends; continuous walkway.

staffing.notes: No dedicated roster. Patrols are counted at barracks or gate nodes.

structures.name: Castle corner tower
structures.purpose: Join curtain runs at turns and provide elevated defence.
structures.placement: Perimeter turns exceeding the kit corner angle.
requirements: Curtain ends compatible with tower join thickness and height.

staffing.notes: Watch posts only; sleeping deferred.

structures.name: Wall-walk stair
structures.purpose: Connect bailey grade to the curtain walkway.
structures.placement: Interior face of a curtain run.
requirements: Walkway continuity through the adjoining segments.

staffing.notes: No dedicated roster.

structures.name: Postern gate
structures.purpose: Secondary personnel exit opposite the main gate.
requirements: Closed perimeter; restricted clearance.

staffing.notes: Guard posts only.

structures.name: Barbican gatehouse
structures.purpose: Primary defended entrance on the approach road.
requirements: Gate clearance; curtain joins on both flanks.

staffing.notes: Gate roster; sleeping deferred.

structures.name: Drawbridge and ditch crossing
structures.purpose: Span the outer ditch on the primary approach.
structures.placement: Immediately outside the barbican when the kit requests a ditch.
requirements: Outer ditch present; gate clearance.

staffing.notes: Operated by gate crew.

structures.name: Bailey courtyard
structures.purpose: Open ward for circulation, musters and service yards inside a ring.
structures.placement: Interior of a closed fortification ring.
requirements: Closed wall network.

staffing.notes: Open court; no dedicated roster.

structures.name: Keep tower
structures.purpose: Command and refuge tower without an embedded courtyard.
requirements: Bailey or motte court available.

staffing.notes: Command roster; residential rooms deferred.

structures.name: Castle great hall
structures.purpose: Assembly and household hall inside the bailey.
requirements: Bailey court.

staffing.notes: Household service roster.

structures.name: Castle chapel
structures.purpose: Small chapel for garrison and household rites.

staffing.notes: Single chaplain post.

structures.name: Castle barracks
structures.purpose: Garrison muster and equipment space inside the bailey.
structures.placement: Outer or main bailey near the gate.

staffing.notes: Muster roster; sleeping deferred.

structures.name: Castle armory
structures.purpose: Secure arms store for the garrison.

staffing.notes: Armorer post only.

structures.name: Castle well
structures.purpose: Independent water supply inside the defended precinct.

staffing.notes: No dedicated roster.

measurement_convention.plot: plot_m is the unrotated reservation: width + left + right, depth + front + rear.

worker_house.name: Worker house
worker_house.notes: Provisional four-worker shared dwelling; no dependent or household multiplier.

worker_apartment.name: Worker apartments
worker_apartment.notes: Four-storey shared worker housing; same reserved plot as a worker house allows deterministic densification. Provisional capacity, no dependents.

hamlet_house.name: Hamlet cottage
hamlet_house.notes: Compact rural dwelling for hamlet staffing; culturally distinct from city worker houses. No apartment densification in planner v1.
